purpose: Known development trajectories only. No native policy calls.
roots: Every sealed pair in early_lane_dev/native_response (four roots) and tree_response_training/supplement_01/batches/intake_06 and intake_07 (all signed completed roots), irrespective of scores. Missing/mismatched pairs explicitly rejected.
primary: Predict a difference in own-minus-opponent gross receipts from successor over a complete next 30 moves; compare with both actual response tapes for the matched successor window and with official terminal difference. Also report H10 and root-indexed H10/H30 realized differences. Exact immediate cash movement of root is added only for the prefixed decision metric. Subcomponents separately reported; the model does not predict expenditures.
scenarios: Observed successor: uses actual shared first rival command, exact private world only when reproducing the real next public observation; oracle test, not deployable.

Legal successor: only focal predecision public history, Feat.est estimated carbon, opponent worker directions extrapolated from consecutive public positions, stationary bases; choose this enemy command before seeing candidate and share across both branches. No seed, hidden opponent carbon or unpublished enemy command enters this scenario.
comparison: For both frozen full-precision income readouts, predeclare pure leaf = expected own delivery+tree minus rival delivery+tree. Add the known immediate net treasury change for combined terminal ordering. Report paired alternative-minus-parent sign, MAE and regret vs constant delta zero; constant rankings split ties half, expected regret abs(realized delta)/2, also report always-parent. Maps equal weight and cases individually, no synthetic terminal repeats. One stochastic continuation per arm.
fit: None. Fixed actors + readouts + support frozen by ../fit_receipt.json; no threshold search.
